descriptionHtml:
Bug B01 · P0 · new

Photo census scan never finds anyone: the vision model wraps its JSON in a ```json block and parseModelJson (convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98) silently returns nothing (Hospital and Nursing Home)

Tickets: TFA-94425 ready for qa; TFA-92580 rejected by qa; TFA-92587 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Also blocks dev U77; U78–U81 paused for the same reason Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92587): it also blocks every Nursing Home scan case on dev (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S08, S17, S18; dev units U77–U81 paused). Re-check 2026-10-16 on 25acd727: still there (convex/ai/vision.ts, modelJson.ts and vertex.ts unchanged since e02167f). With a scripted read, everything after the read passes locally (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S17); the cases stay failed until a real photo is read. Re-check 2026-10-17 on dev 25acd727 (TFA-92580, TC-02): 14 of 14 photo reads empty while the model answered (gemini-3.6-flash, ok, 2.3–9.9 s); in-process on 25acd727 code a ```json-fenced reply gives 0 rows and bare JSON 3.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-03/S18, TC-09/S06, TC-09/S07, TC-09/S08, TC-09/S17, TC-02/S01, TC-02/S02, TC-02/S06, TC-02/S07, TC-02/S08, TC-02/S14, TC-02/S16

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S04 Supervisor-list photo with 2 known and 2 new residents: counts first, all four on Today's Visits, known data kept, new ones Follow-up with nothing invented

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 3; TFA-92587 How it works 3)
  • U3 The photo uses the same deduplication against All Residents as TC-02. Before anything is written, the physician sees how many residents are already known and how many are new (e.g. … (UAT TC-09; UAT TC-02 (by reference); TFA-92587 AC 3)
  • U7 New residents, whether added by photo or by hand, land in All Residents as Follow-up (TC-06 defaults). (UAT TC-09; UAT TC-06 (by reference); TFA-92587 AC 5; TFA-92587 How it works 5)
  • U10 The supervisor-list scan writes only what the photo shows: a field that is not on the photo (MRN, unit, DOB) stays blank and is never generated, and the scan lists no row that is not on the photo. (UAT TC-02 ('a scan never invents an MRN or room; a field the photo didn't have is left blank'); UAT 3.4)
  • T2 Photo scanning runs on Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. (TFA-94425 AC 1)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given All Residents holds QA Alder (unit 'Oak 1A', MRN 'QA-MRN-1001-<tag>', New Admission, Important Point 'QA point Alder', not In Today) and QA Birch (Oak 2, MRN 'QA-MRN-1002-<tag>', Follow-up, not In Today), plus the fixture resident (In Today, MRN 'QA-<tag>-10'). …

When Scan resident list → Take Photo or Choose Image → upload the supervisor list → confirm adding to Today's Visits → Today's Visits → All Residents → QA Alder's, QA Dahlia's and QA Elm's charts

Then Before anything is written the sheet lists exactly the 4 photographed rows and says 2 are already known and 2 are new. After confirming, Today's Visits lists Alder, Birch, Dahlia and Elm. All Residents lists each of them. QA Alder keeps unit Oak 1A, MRN QA-MRN-1001, New Admission and its Important Point (the photo's 'Oak 1' does not overwrite it). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: s04-sheet has '4 residents found' (no extra or missing row, U10), '2 already' and '2 new' (U3; exact wording is Q2); s04-today has all four and mustNotContain 'In Today ✓' (U2); s04-all has all four with 'Oak 1A', 'New Admission' and 'In Today ✓' (U3 keeps its data); s04-alder-chart keeps unit, MRN, badge and Important Point (U3); …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S04 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-09/S04

Supervisor-list photo with 2 known and 2 new residents: counts first, all four on Today's Visits, known data kept, new ones Follow-up with nothing invented

Tickets: TFA-92587 All Residents Attendance Toggle (ready for qa); TFA-94425 Implement Vision/photo path (ready for qa)

Re-verdict after the QA review of TFA-92587 (2026-10-16; not yet checked by Quinn): failed. Local 25acd727 with a scripted read (package rst, 2026-10-16): '4 found · 2 already · 2 new'; all four on today; Alder keeps its unit, MRN, New Admission and Important Point; new residents are Follow-up (16/16). The real read still returns nothing (B01, code unchanged), so a physician scanning a photo sees 'No residents found'. Failed on B01 until the read is fixed. The run's own result was pass; its evidence is below.

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Local, rst-tc09-scans.spec.ts: the real Nursing Home scan sheet with ai/vision:scanCensusSheet answered at the Convex socket with the exact rows the case's photo lists (the photo is a neutral fixture image; the read itself — Vertex / B01 — is not exercised); fresh physician per case, names 'QA TC-09-Sxx <word>' as the matrix asks. Open questions recorded, never judged (brief 2026-10-16): Q1 (the scan replaces today's list), Q6 (a row with no MRN is stored with a generated 'SNF-######' MRN), Q8 (a known name with another MRN), Q2 (count wording). T2 / U9 (Vertex Gemini read the photo; model and AI time logged) cannot be checked locally: the read never reaches the server; the 10-15 dev photo10 run logged them (gemini-3.6-flash, providerMs) but every live read returns no rows (B01, still on 25acd727: convex/ai/vision.ts + convex/lib/modelJson.ts parseModelJson unchanged, no fence stripping, Vertex has no JSON mode). S04: 16/16 judged pass — sheet '4 residents found' and '2 already in All Residents · 2 new · 0 to review' before anything is written (backend unchanged at that point); after 'Add 4 to Today's Visits' Alder, Birch, Dahlia and Elm are on Today's Visits and in All Residents, each exactly once; Alder keeps unit Oak 1A, its MRN, New Admission and its Important Point (card, backend and chart); Dahlia and Elm are Follow-up with the photo's units and no DOB; no Hospital patient in Nursing Home. Recorded: Q6 — Dahlia and Elm were stored with generated MRNs (SNF-443084, SNF-623195) shown on their charts; Q1 — the fixture resident (In Today, not on the photo) left Today's Visits without a prompt (judged in S08's frame, recorded).

Evidence: 7 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: permission-add-patient, synthetic-media. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
